An oversized serif identity and a narrow purple qualifications rail create a studio folio. Projects lead the evidence column, with clear dates and text links to external work.
Use a delicate green perimeter rule, a warm serif identity and generous white space. Suggest botanical calm through line and colour rather than illustrations that compete with content.
A clay-coloured identity rail and broad white work column give a tactile, grounded character. Use soft rectangular dividers and clear project titles without textured backgrounds.
An orderly two-column grid and small alternating purple keylines suggest a woven structure. Keep the body plain and use typographic hierarchy rather than decorative pattern behind text.
A small abstract colour composition lives only in the outer identity margin. The career text remains a calm reading column with a narrow supporting rail and dark section labels.

A friendly serif identity and pencil-like red dividers support a project-forward resume. Avoid requiring illustrations inside the document; portfolio links and applicant-supplied photos remain optional.
A restrained monochrome identity and narrow information rail evoke a contact-sheet index. Use numbered sections and a broad work column without making image thumbnails essential.
An offset blue identity block and staggered section rules suggest movement on a static page. Keep entry text in a conventional order and avoid animation in the resume itself.
Fine drafting-like rules, marginal dates and a precise serif identity form an architectural document. Keep project names prominent and resist decorative diagrams or fake measurement marks.
A broad career column and pale green qualifications rail balance technical and creative work. Use a calm serif identity and short rules that leave long project titles room to wrap.
A compact stamp-like identity frame leads a warm, practical resume. Strong project headings and understated section numbers convey care without simulated paper texture or a fabricated logo.
Use a dignified serif identity and marginal dates for projects, engagements and teaching. Publications and credentials retain clear standard labels, and long programme titles must wrap comfortably.
A large byline-style identity and two disciplined columns recall a programme. Keep credits represented by the resume's supplied projects and work entries, with no invented productions or billing.
A quiet exhibition-label masthead sits above a broad career narrative and narrow credentials rail. Use warm neutrals, plain dates and generous spacing around institutions and publications.
A dark green identity rail and warm serif headings balance practical experience with creative character. Give venues, certifications and languages a clear hierarchy without decorative food imagery.
A confident personal-letterhead masthead introduces a project-forward single column. Use compact blue keylines and clear client context while retaining the full work chronology.
